sample_values.notes: Excluded by EFSA from statistics because it exceeded any other sample in the sub-category by >10x; form (powder vs beans) not stated.

exposure.statement: Reference points: BMDL01 for developmental neurotoxicity 12 µg B-Pb/L (0.50 µg/kg b.w./day dietary); systolic blood pressure BMDL01 36 µg/L (1.50 µg/kg b.w./day); chronic kidney disease BMDL10 15 µg/L (0.63 µg/kg b.w./day). Current PTWI of 25 µg/kg b.w. no longer appropriate.

Coffee, tea and cocoa converted to liquid for exposure using dilution factor 10 for cocoa (20 g cocoa powder in 180 ml), giving adjusted category mean 0.0034 (LB) - 0.0045 (UB) mg/kg; cocoa not separated in exposure contributions.
Sugar and sugar products including chocolate: adjusted mean 0.0403 (LB) - 0.0644 (UB) mg/kg used for exposure.

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Stored summary row 'Cocoa powder/beans (154)' matches the primary; it omits the chocolate and chocolate products statistics (n=315, LB mean 68.1, UB 82.8 µg/kg, P95 173-227, max 1240) and the excluded 14.1 mg/kg cocoa outlier.
unresolved: 'Chocolate and chocolate products' includes chocolate-based (mixed) products; plain chocolate cannot be separated.
Cocoa category mixes powder and beans.
US TDS milk chocolate candy bar value kept as secondary_citation; take from primary if available.
